title: b7z9.37.1.2(a): root-sig COSE decode + structural validation in lichen-node
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.1.2 (decisions recorded on parent comment: ciborium 0.2, lichen-link::schnorr for alpha-2, AddrForKey=SHA-512 ygg_addr_from_pubkey precedent). New rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/root_sig.rs: decode COSE_Sign1 (tag-18 array(4): protected map alg==-65537, unprotected kid 8-byte IID, payload CBOR map keys 1-7 -> RootSigPayload {dodag_id [u8;16], instance u8, version u8, rank u16, expiry u64, root_seq u64, mop u8}, signature 48B) via ciborium; structural checks WITHOUT signature verify: IID binding (sha512(pubkey)[:8] &0xfd bit per identity.py:138), DODAGID binding (== ygg_addr_from_pubkey, router.rs:109), expiry > now, DIO cross-checks (instance/version/rank/mop) with error strings matching the Python oracle (IID_MISMATCH, DODAG_ID_MISMATCH, EXPIRED, *_MISMATCH). Tests from committed root_dio_signature.json fixtures (valid basic, wrong_algorithm, kid_mismatch, impersonation->DodagIdMismatch, rank/expiry cases). Add ciborium = 0.2 to lichen-node.
